hunks.baseline: How could I ever forget that name? The demonic being who was the starting point of every catastrophe, its very source.
hunks.sol: How could I forget that name? The demon who was the beginning and the source of every catastrophe.

hunks.baseline: “I-I didn’t do it because I wanted to! Have you forgotten that it was all on the king’s orders?”
hunks.sol: “I-I didn’t do it because I wanted to! Have you forgotten? The king ordered all of it!”

hunks.baseline: I silently looked down at the Doppelganger, shouting in desperation. After a brief moment of hesitation, I drew back the internal energy I’d been channeling through my foot.
hunks.sol: I looked down at the Doppelganger as it cried out in desperation. After a brief struggle with myself, I drew back the internal energy I’d been channeling into my foot.

hunks.baseline: “Cough, hack.”
hunks.sol: “Cough—hack.”

hunks.baseline: The pressure on its chest lifted, and it immediately broke into a fit of coughing.
hunks.sol: The pressure on its chest lifted, and it broke into a fit of coughing.

hunks.baseline: The Doppelganger let out the breath it had been holding, then glared at me with eyes full of pain and fury. But deep inside them, fear lurked—fear it hadn’t quite managed to hide.
hunks.sol: It expelled the breath it had been holding and glared at me, fury and pain mingling in its eyes. But fear lurked deep within them, not quite hidden.

hunks.baseline: It looked so helpless that it was hard to believe it had once been a named monster at Level 170.
hunks.sol: It looked so helpless that it was hard to believe it had been a named monster at Level 170.

hunks.baseline: But the small shadow before me now was the Doppelganger’s true nature. Its one and only truth.
hunks.sol: Yet the little shadow before me was the Doppelganger’s essence. Its one and only truth.

hunks.baseline: It had taken whatever it could, absorbed it, and digested it.
hunks.sol: It had taken whatever it could, absorbed it, digested it.

hunks.baseline: It had climbed to the heights of power on the backs of those lives, using them as food and stepping-stones.
hunks.sol: Those lives had fed it and served as steps on its climb to power.

hunks.baseline: But today, the feast it had so happily gorged itself on would come to an end.
hunks.sol: But today, the feast it had enjoyed for so long was over.

hunks.baseline: Its fanatical followers, who’d worshiped it like a god, were gone. So was its army of monsters. With no one beside it, only one path remained.
hunks.sol: The fanatics who worshiped it like a god were gone. So was its army of monsters. With no one at its side, only one path remained open to it.

hunks.baseline: The crushing pressure I’d lifted a moment ago bore down through the tip of my foot once more. I watched the Doppelganger let out a muffled groan, then continued in a low voice.
hunks.sol: The crushing pressure I’d lifted a moment ago bore down through the tip of my foot once more. I watched the Doppelganger stifle a groan, then continued quietly.

hunks.baseline: Evil itself, and its source.
hunks.sol: Evil itself. The source of it.

hunks.baseline: What I wanted from the Doppelganger was information about that accursed being—and the future of this world.
hunks.sol: What I wanted from the Doppelganger was information about that accursed being—and about the future of this world.

hunks.baseline: The hoarse voice that slipped from my lips sounded like someone else’s.
hunks.sol: The hoarse voice that came from my mouth sounded like someone else’s.

hunks.baseline: My mouth felt as rough as if I’d swallowed a handful of sand. It wasn’t just exhaustion and thirst.
hunks.sol: My mouth felt as though I’d swallowed a handful of sand. Exhaustion and thirst weren’t the only reasons.

hunks.baseline: Each syllable was a struggle. I didn’t dare say it aloud, or even imagine it.
hunks.sol: Every syllable was a struggle. I didn’t want to say the words, much less imagine what they meant.

hunks.baseline: I knew what became of those who turned away from reality, and what waited beyond the reality they’d tried so hard to ignore.
hunks.sol: I knew what became of people who turned away from reality. I knew what lurked beyond the reality they tried so hard not to face.

hunks.baseline: To escape a forest fire, you have to recognize that the fire is there.
hunks.sol: To escape a forest fire, you first have to know it’s there.

hunks.baseline: You have to see the smoke billowing up and the red flames raging, and feel the heat that threatens to burn you alive.
hunks.sol: You have to see the rising smoke and the red flames, feel the heat that threatens to burn you alive.

hunks.baseline: In the suffocating silence, the sound of little bits of stone falling from overhead rang out with unusual clarity.
hunks.sol: In the suffocating silence, the patter of small stones falling from overhead sounded unusually loud.

hunks.baseline: Neither I, nor the Skeleton King, nor the Doppelganger spoke.
hunks.sol: I said nothing. Neither did the Skeleton King or the Doppelganger.

hunks.baseline: Not for a brief moment.
hunks.sol: For a moment, none of us spoke.

hunks.baseline: Until I heard the whisper of a shadow, something not of this world.
hunks.sol: Then the shadow whispered.

hunks.baseline: “Is he still alive?”
hunks.sol: “Alive?”

hunks.baseline: The darkness rippled. A pitch-black abyss, where its features were barely distinguishable, split into a long grin.
hunks.sol: The darkness rippled. Its pitch-black face, its features barely discernible, split into a long grin.

hunks.baseline: “You do not know, Chosen One. And yet you are also a foolish mortal, destined one day to be broken by time and crumble into dust.”
hunks.sol: “You know nothing, Chosen One. Foolish mortal. One day, time will break you, and you will crumble into dust.”

hunks.baseline: It had forgotten its anger, pain, and fear of me.
hunks.sol: It seemed to have forgotten its anger at me, its pain, its fear.

hunks.baseline: Or perhaps it had covered them all with the presence of its absent master.
hunks.sol: Or perhaps the presence of its absent master had swallowed them all.

hunks.baseline: “Our Great King overcame the curse of the gods. He may waver, but he will not break. Even if he perishes, he will rise again. And at last, he will make all the earth and water in this world his own.”
hunks.sol: “The Great King overcame a god’s curse. He may waver, but he will not break. Even if he falls, he will rise again. And at last, he will make all the earth and water in this world his own.”

hunks.baseline: “That is the only truth. A truth you cannot stop, even knowing it—a truth that will become reality in the not-too-distant future.”
hunks.sol: “That is the only truth. A truth you cannot stop, even now that you know it. Before long, it will become reality.”

hunks.baseline: I stared blankly at the Doppelganger, laughing aloud.
hunks.sol: I stared blankly at the Doppelganger as it laughed aloud.

hunks.baseline: And the moment I met its eyes, darkness swirling within them, I felt my vision grow hazy.
hunks.sol: The moment I met its eyes, darkness swirling within them, my vision swam.

hunks.baseline: *This is…*
hunks.sol: *What is this?*

hunks.baseline: No sound came from my throat. The sand and rubble that had filled the area, the Skeleton King, the Doppelganger—they all vanished.
hunks.sol: No sound came out. The dust and rubble around us vanished. So did the Skeleton King and the Doppelganger.

hunks.baseline: No. It felt as though my entire consciousness was being pulled somewhere.
hunks.sol: No—it felt as though my entire consciousness was being pulled away.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a vision unlike anything I’d ever seen came pouring into view like a meteor shower.
hunks.sol: At the same time, sights unlike anything I’d ever seen poured before my eyes like a meteor shower.

hunks.baseline: *SHWAAAAA…*
hunks.sol: *SHWAAAA…*

hunks.baseline: A brilliant sun rose in the east, bathing the world in light. Clouds raced across the blue sky. Before long, the moon rose with the glow of sunset, and darkness fell.
hunks.sol: A brilliant sun rose in the east, painting the world with light. Clouds raced across the blue sky. Sunset came, then the moon rose and darkness fell.

hunks.baseline: One day, then another.
hunks.sol: One day. Then another.

hunks.baseline: It rushed by like a scene from a nature documentary I’d once watched, but there was nothing beautiful about it.
hunks.sol: Time sped past like a scene from a nature documentary I’d once watched. But there was nothing beautiful about it.

hunks.baseline: *BOOOOM!*
hunks.sol: *BOOM!*

hunks.baseline: The wild animals living in the vast wilderness bolted all at once, as if on cue. With flames like a setting sun at their backs, monsters marched across the horizon.
hunks.sol: Wild animals scattered across the vast wilderness, all bolting at once as if on cue. Behind them, monsters advanced across the horizon with flames the color of sunset at their backs.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of thousands. Millions.
hunks.sol: Tens of thousands. Millions.

hunks.baseline: A horde of monsters beyond counting poured in from every direction. They shook the earth and blotted out the sky.
hunks.sol: An army of monsters beyond counting poured in from every direction. They shook the earth and blotted out the sky.

hunks.baseline: Huge wings swept across the clouds and blotted out the sunlight. Then, all at once, the shadow they cast fell over my eyes.
hunks.sol: Huge wings swept through them, blocking the sunlight. Then the shadow they cast fell over me.

hunks.baseline: My vision flipped. The sky and earth turned upside down.
hunks.sol: My view flipped. Sky and earth turned upside down.

hunks.baseline: And in the transformed landscape, I saw a city burning.
hunks.sol: In that inverted landscape, I saw a city burning.

hunks.baseline: *BOOOOM!*
hunks.sol: *BOOM!*

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of cannons fired at once. As giants standing shoulder to shoulder with skyscrapers staggered, engulfed in flames, figures shot forward like streaks of light and charged through the ruined streets.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of cannons fired at once. Giants as tall as skyscrapers staggered, engulfed in flames, while figures shot like streaks of light through the ruined streets and charged at them.

hunks.baseline: They wielded weapons blazing with radiance and shouted their resolve as if spitting blood.
hunks.sol: Their weapons blazed with radiance. They shouted their resolve as if coughing up blood.

hunks.baseline: The sword and shield protecting humanity from the accursed beings.
hunks.sol: Humanity’s sword and shield against those accursed beings.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t even twitch a finger. From high above, I watched their magnificent charge.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t move a finger. From high above, I watched their magnificent charge.

hunks.baseline: They fought monsters dozens of times their number. As if to prove their cries true, they never retreated. They fell, spraying their blood for humanity.
hunks.sol: They fought monsters that outnumbered them dozens of times over. True to their cries, they never retreated. They shed their blood for humanity and fell.

hunks.baseline: Until the very last one.
hunks.sol: Until the last of them was gone.

hunks.baseline: As if someone were controlling me, I saw Niagara Falls turn red with blood. I saw hundreds crushed to death beneath the shattered Leaning Tower of Pisa.
hunks.sol: As if someone else controlled where I looked, I saw Niagara Falls run red with blood. I saw hundreds crushed to death beneath the shattered Leaning Tower of Pisa.

hunks.baseline: I was a consciousness that did not exist, nothing more than a spectator.
hunks.sol: I was a consciousness without a body. Nothing more than a spectator.

hunks.baseline: In a landscape changing without pause, the one right—and curse—granted to me was to see the civilization burning to ash and hear the screams of the dying.
hunks.sol: As the scene changed without pause, my only right—and my curse—was to watch civilization burn to ash and hear the screams of the dying.

hunks.baseline: Countless deaths. And destruction.
hunks.sol: Death beyond counting. Destruction.

hunks.baseline: The streets were carpeted with corpses. A broken church cross lay plunged into a pool of blood.
hunks.sol: Corpses covered the streets. A broken church cross lay plunged into a pool of blood.

hunks.baseline: A child, unaware of what had happened to their parents, could no longer bear the hunger and crawled out of a small box. When the child saw a pack of goblins in the alley, the doll in their hand fell to the ground.
hunks.sol: A child who had no idea what had happened to their parents could no longer bear the hunger and crawled out of a small box. In the alley, the child saw a pack of goblins and dropped the doll in their hand.

hunks.baseline: A word for an unexpected, unfortunate disaster.
hunks.sol: A word for an unforeseen calamity.

hunks.baseline: But even that word, a symbol of the Great Cataclysm, could not begin to describe the horrors I had seen.
hunks.sol: But even that word, the one that defined the Great Cataclysm, couldn’t describe the horrors I’d seen.

hunks.baseline: In place of the voice that wouldn’t come, one word suddenly occurred to me.
hunks.sol: Unable to speak, I found myself thinking of another word.

hunks.baseline: Yes. It was the end.
hunks.sol: Yes. This was the end.

hunks.baseline: The civilization humanity had built over countless years was destroyed, and not a glimmer of hope remained in people’s hearts.
hunks.sol: The civilization humanity had built over countless years lay in ruins, and not a scrap of hope remained in anyone’s heart.

hunks.baseline: To be exact, their hope was already dead.
hunks.sol: More precisely, their hope was already dead.

hunks.baseline: Torn into hundreds or thousands of pieces, they disappeared into the bellies of hungry monsters.
hunks.sol: Torn into hundreds or thousands of pieces, they had disappeared into the bellies of hungry monsters.

hunks.baseline: “For Magic Johnson.”
hunks.sol: “To Magic Johnson.”

hunks.baseline: A quiet voice rang out across a vast plaza flickering with countless candles.
hunks.sol: A quiet voice carried across a vast plaza lit by countless flickering candles.

hunks.baseline: Xiao Shen lifted a bottle with tearful eyes and filled the empty glass.
hunks.sol: Xiao Shen lifted a bottle, her eyes wet, and filled it again.

hunks.baseline: As I heard the names called out with every glass filled and drained, I understood.
hunks.sol: As names were called with every glass filled and emptied, I understood.

hunks.baseline: A send-off ceremony, a final remembrance of the heroes who had gone before us—the people who had been humanity’s hope.
hunks.sol: A send-off before battle, one last remembrance of the heroes who had gone ahead—the people who had been humanity’s hope.

hunks.baseline: “To the bravest man of all.”
hunks.sol: “To the bravest of us all.”

hunks.baseline: “To the light of humanity, who always illuminated the way for everyone as he stood against the darkness.”
hunks.sol: “To the light of humanity, who stood against the darkness and always lit the way for everyone.”

hunks.baseline: My figure was nowhere to be seen.
hunks.sol: I was nowhere to be seen.

hunks.baseline: The trembling voice came to an end. Team Leader Choi drained yet another glass and clenched his fist.
hunks.sol: The trembling voice fell silent. Team Leader Choi drained yet another glass and clenched his fist.

hunks.baseline: Blood ran from his hand, mingling with the shards of the shattered glass and dripping onto the ground. The candles went out all at once, and silence fell over the entire plaza.
hunks.sol: The glass shattered. Blood ran from his hand with the shards and spattered the ground. Every candle went out at once, and silence settled over the plaza.

hunks.baseline: Though cracked and broken, its blade still held a keen edge. Brilliant radiance welled up from it.
hunks.sol: Cracked and broken though it was, its blade still held a keen edge. Brilliant light welled up along it, spreading across the candleless plaza and faintly illuminating the deep darkness.

hunks.baseline: The light embraced the entire plaza, where the candles had gone out, and faintly lit the deep darkness.
A powerful wind, which had come from far away while no one was watching, whipped dozens of large and small flags.
hunks.sol: A powerful wind swept in from afar and whipped dozens of flags, large and small.

hunks.baseline: A crossed sword and shield. Roughly depicted, but unmistakable: the emblem on the World Hunter Federation’s flag.
hunks.sol: A crossed sword and shield. The design was crudely drawn, but I recognized it: the flag of the World Hunter Federation.

hunks.baseline: Thousands—perhaps tens of thousands—of feet stamped against the ground. The radiance gathered on the Hero’s Sword picked out their faces one by one.
hunks.sol: Thousands—perhaps tens of thousands—of feet stamped the ground. The light gathered on the Hero’s Sword picked out their faces one by one.

hunks.baseline: Blades clashed in the air, spitting sparks. The tanks slammed and pounded their massive tower shields like mad.
hunks.sol: Blades struck one another overhead, throwing sparks. The tanks slammed and pounded their massive tower shields like mad.

hunks.baseline: As if a giant heart were beating, they moved with a single purpose.
hunks.sol: They moved with a single purpose, like the pulse of one enormous heart.

hunks.baseline: For those who had gone before them, and for the battle ahead, they looked to their new Alliance Leader.
hunks.sol: For those who had gone before them, and as they waited for the battle ahead, they looked to their new Alliance Leader.

hunks.baseline: “Today, we fight until the very last person.”
hunks.sol: “Today, we fight to the last.”

hunks.baseline: *Chachachachang!*
hunks.sol: *Clang-clang-clang!*

hunks.baseline: Countless auras surged up at once, as if on cue. Their distant roar, raised as one voice, drove back the darkness.
hunks.sol: Countless auras surged upward at once, as if on cue. Their distant cry rose as one voice and drove back the darkness.

hunks.baseline: The candles that had lit the plaza had long since gone out, but humanity’s flame still burned.
hunks.sol: The candles that had lit the plaza were long since out, but humanity’s flame still burned.

hunks.baseline: Until the darkness that would extinguish their final flame drew near.
hunks.sol: Until the darkness came to extinguish that final flame.

hunks.baseline: At that moment.
hunks.sol: At that moment, the wind stopped.

hunks.baseline: The wind stopped. The air trembled.
hunks.sol: The air trembled.

hunks.baseline: The plaza, heated to a fever pitch, turned cold. Countless eyes shifted in the same direction.
hunks.sol: The plaza, heated to a fever pitch, went cold. Countless eyes turned in the same direction.

hunks.baseline: And there, stood a being cloaked in darkness.
hunks.sol: There stood a being cloaked in darkness.

hunks.baseline: A moan slipped through someone’s lips and pierced my ears.
hunks.sol: A moan escaped someone’s lips and reached my ears.

hunks.baseline: My senses, floating as if submerged in water, came back to me. The hairs all over my body stood on end.
hunks.sol: My senses, which had felt distant and buoyant, as though I were submerged in water, returned. Every hair on my body stood on end.

hunks.baseline: An instinctive fear and wariness stirred. Unlike before, I moved my head of my own free will. Following everyone’s gaze, I looked at him.
hunks.sol: Instinctive fear and wariness rose in me. Unlike before, I turned my head of my own will. Following everyone’s gaze, I looked at him.

hunks.baseline: The accursed king who had once—and would again, in a future that had yet to begin—cast humanity into the flames.
hunks.sol: The accursed king who had driven humanity into the flames in the past—and would do so in a future that had yet to begin.

hunks.baseline: And the moment I stared into the writhing darkness in the distance—
hunks.sol: I stared at the darkness writhing in the distance.
